title: Exercise-related abdominal complaints in a large cohort of runners: a survey with a particular focus on nutrition
claims: Of 1,993 surveyed runners, 1,139 (57%) reported abdominal discomfort during running or within 3 hours after running.
Upper abdominal discomfort was reported by 302 runners (15%), lower abdominal discomfort by 1,115 (56%), and both by 278 (14%).
About one third of runners with symptoms said the discomfort affected their running.
Female sex, younger age and higher running intensity were positively associated with abdominal discomfort.
Prevalence of gastrointestinal symptoms in distance runners across studies ranges from 30% to 90%.

verification.note: PMC 全文可读（摘要、方法、结果均可见）；横断面自报问卷设计，1,993 人为完成两份问卷并排除不可信膳食摄入后的样本。
